summary: Bell Canada announced pricing for cash tender offers to purchase up to a Maximum Purchase Amount of six series of its outstanding USD-denominated notes. The offers cover US$3.405 billion in aggregate principal, with Total Consideration per US$1,000 principal ranging from $665.35 to $875.60, based on fixed spreads over reference Treasury yields. The notes are guaranteed by parent BCE Inc. Acceptance priority levels rank the series 1-6. The tender is funded by cash on hand and/or new financing. Mechanics include a Maximum Purchase Condition and pro-ration. The early tender deadline was May 27, 2026; expiration is June 10, 2026. Risk-arb watch: note price convergence to tender consideration as settlement approaches
